description: The image displays a donut chart illustrating the win rates of different large language models, with the central white ring labeled "Win rate (%)". The chart is divided into three distinct segments, each representing a model and its corresponding win rate percentage. The largest segment, colored dark red, corresponds to GPT-4o, which has a win rate of 98.4%. A smaller, light blue segment represents LLaMA, with a win rate of 3.2%. The smallest segment, colored dark blue, is labeled Mistral and shows a win rate of 1.2%. Each segment is clearly labeled with its model name and percentage value via a line extending from the slice to the text. The segments are arranged in a clockwise direction, with GPT-4o occupying the majority of the outer ring, followed by LLaMA, and then Mistral. The chart effectively visualizes the significant performance difference between GPT-4o and the other two models.
